title: UL-13 — Challenge: DynamoDB
scenario: Add a GSI, query it, then remove the GSI before table delete.
acceptanceCriteria: One GSI exists with projection ALL or KEYS_ONLY documented.
Query uses GSI not Scan for lookup pattern.
At least three items indexed on GSI partition key.
After query proof, GSI is deleted via UpdateTable.
Table still operable on base key after GSI removal.
describe-table shows no GSIs after update.
Query output captured in local notes only.

verification: aws resourcegroupstaggingapi get-resources --tag-filters Key=LabId,Values=ul-13 returns an empty ResourceTagMappingList in $env:AWS_REGION
aws resourcegroupstaggingapi get-resources --tag-filters Key=LabId,Values=gl-13 returns an empty ResourceTagMappingList in $env:AWS_REGION
